title: TowMi
shortDescription: A towing and automotive shop locator with real-time maps and messaging.
description: TowMi is a capstone project designed to connect vehicle owners with nearby towing companies and automotive repair shops. It includes interactive maps, real-time messaging, shop profiles, and search/filter capabilities.

title: Business Analytics Dashboard
shortDescription: Interactive dashboard for business performance monitoring.
description: A Power BI dashboard that transforms raw sales and operational data into meaningful KPIs and visualizations for decision making.

title: Company Website
description: A responsive business website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Lead Generation Automation
shortDescription: Automated lead collection and reporting workflow.
description: Automation workflow that gathers leads, cleans data, and exports reports automatically.
